# dlaset

> Initializes an M-by-N matrix A to BETA on the diagonal and ALPHA on the.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import dlaset from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/dlaset';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
dlaset( order, uplo, M, N, alpha, beta, A, LDA ) → Float64Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `uplo` | `"upper" \| "lower" \| "all"` | `'upper'` or `'lower'`, otherwise full matrix |
| `M` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of rows |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of columns |
| `alpha` | `number` | Off-diagonal value |
| `beta` | `number` | Diagonal value |
| `A` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>M × N</sub> | **out** · Input matrix |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies the part of the matrix A to be set.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part is set; the strictly lower triangular part of A is not changed.
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part is set; the strictly upper triangular part of A is not changed. Otherwise:  All of the matrix A is set.
- `M`: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.
- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `alpha`: The constant to which the offdiagonal elements are to be set.
- `beta`: The constant to which the diagonal elements are to be set.
- `A`: On exit, the leading m-by-n submatrix of A is set as follows:

  if `UPLO = 'U'`, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $1 \le i \le j-1$, $1 \le j \le n$, if `UPLO = 'L'`, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $j+1 \le i \le m$, $1 \le j \le n$, otherwise, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $1 \le i \le m$, $1 \le j \le n$, $i \ne j$,

  and, for all `UPLO`, $A(i,i) = \mathrm{BETA}$, $1 \le i \le \min (m,n)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: output array

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be one of the following: "upper", "lower", "all"

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
dlaset.ndarray( uplo, M, N, alpha, beta, A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA ) → Float64Array
```

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `uplo` | `"upper" \| "lower" \| "all"` | `'upper'` or `'lower'`, otherwise full matrix |
| `M` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of rows |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of columns |
| `alpha` | `number` | Off-diagonal value |
| `beta` | `number` | Diagonal value |
| `A` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>M × N</sub> | **out** · Input/output matrix |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `A` |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `A` |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `A` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies the part of the matrix A to be set.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part is set; the strictly lower triangular part of A is not changed.
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part is set; the strictly upper triangular part of A is not changed. Otherwise:  All of the matrix A is set.
- `M`: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.
- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `alpha`: The constant to which the offdiagonal elements are to be set.
- `beta`: The constant to which the diagonal elements are to be set.
- `A`: On exit, the leading m-by-n submatrix of A is set as follows:

  if `UPLO = 'U'`, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $1 \le i \le j-1$, $1 \le j \le n$, if `UPLO = 'L'`, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $j+1 \le i \le m$, $1 \le j \le n$, otherwise, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $1 \le i \le m$, $1 \le j \le n$, $i \ne j$,

  and, for all `UPLO`, $A(i,i) = \mathrm{BETA}$, $1 \le i \le \min (m,n)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: A

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be one of the following: "upper", "lower", "all"
- `RangeError` second argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` third argument must be a nonnegative integer

</section>

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `dlaset()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`DLASET`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/dlaset.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import discreteUniform from '@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform/lib/index.js';
import dlaset from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/dlaset';

/** @type {{ dtype: 'float64' }} */
const opts = {
	'dtype': 'float64'
};
const N = 3;
const A = discreteUniform( N * N, -10, 10, opts );

// Using the standard interface:
let out = dlaset( 'row-major', 'upper', N, N, 1.0, 1.0, A, N );
console.log( out );

// Using the ndarray interface:
out = dlaset.ndarray( 'upper', N, N, 1.0, 1.0, A, N, 1, 0 );
console.log( out );
```

</section>
